description: This file implements the ReportMailingJobReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve report mailing job data, including listing all jobs, active jobs, and specific job details. It uses JDBC templates for database access and maps SQL result sets to data objects.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the service interface for accessing report mailing job data from the database, including listing, retrieving active jobs, specific jobs, and enum options. Uses JDBC and SQL generation for database interactions.

methods.name: retrieveAllReportMailingJobs
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of all report mailing jobs based on search parameters, including sorting and limits.

methods.name: retrieveAllActiveReportMailingJobs
methods.description: Retrieves all active (not deleted and is_active=true) report mailing jobs.

methods.name: retrieveReportMailingJob
methods.description: Fetches detailed data for a specific report mailing job by its ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: retrieveReportMailingJobEnumOptions
methods.description: Provides enum options for email attachment file formats and stretchy report parameter date options.
